qualification.education_qualification: Graduate/ post graduate degree preferably in commerce/ banking & finance
qualification.details: Consultant : Graduate/ post graduate degree preferably in commerce/ banking & finance from a recognized University. Minimum 10 years working experience in the relevant field i.e. agriculture credits/ financing/ enforcement/ banking/ insurance/ commodity markets. Retired Government/ Central and State PSU/ Statutory/ Autonomous Bodies official with minimum 10 years of experience in relevant field. Worked in grade pay of Rs. 6600/ - or above for at least 5 years before retirement. No criminal/ vigilance proceedings.

salary_details.pay_scale: 50% of last pay drawn at the time of retirement
salary_details.details: Maximum amount of monthly consolidated fee payable to the Consultant shall be 50% of the last pay drawn at the time of retirement. Pay includes basic pay and DA / IDA. No other allowance shall be payable. Income tax shall be deducted at source at the prescribed rate. Payment of other taxes, if applicable, shall be the responsibility of the Consultant. An appropriate and fixed amount as Transport Allowance for the purpose of commuting between the residence and the place of work shall be allowed not exceeding the rate applicable to the appointee at the time of retirement. The amount so fixed shall remain unchanged during the term of appointment. In addition to above, for Consultants from Central and State PSUs, the amount of Transport Allowance shall be fixed based on equivalency of pay scale of PSU with Central Government or as decided by Chairperson, WDRA. No other allowance shall be payable.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for WDRA Consultant Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.

Check all details carefully before submission.

Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WDRA Consultant (Banking) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the WDRA Consultant (Banking) post is 10 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant (Banking) post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduate/post graduate degree preferably in commerce/banking & finance from a recognized University. Retired officials with relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Consultant (Banking) position is 64 years as of the closing date of the application.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Consultant (Banking) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on predefined criteria, followed by an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Consultant (Banking) position?
faq.answer: The salary will be a maximum of 50% of the last pay drawn at the time of retirement, including basic pay and DA/IDA. No other allowances will be payable.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the WDRA Consultant (Banking) recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the WDRA Consultant (Banking) posts?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it by post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Consultant (Banking) position?
faq.answer: The Consultant (Banking) position is on a contractual basis. This means the appointment will be for a fixed term as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority (WDRA), which is www.wdra.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the experience required for the Consultant (Banking) role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 10 years of working experience in the relevant field, such as agriculture credits, financing, banking, or insurance, is required. Retired officials who meet this criterion are eligible.
